parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of steel for strength and durability. It is a curved rod attached to the bucket body.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, typically cylindrical and made of plastic to hold liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the container portion of the bucket, holding the contents securely.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid part that does not move independently; it supports the handle and contains the load.
